description: This file implements support for handling timezone updates by monitoring a timezone configuration file, reading its contents, and updating environment variables accordingly within the WPEFramework namespace.

classes.name: TimeZoneSupport
classes.description: A class that manages monitoring a timezone configuration file, updating the system environment, and providing initialization and cleanup of the file monitoring process.

methods.name: HandleTimeZoneFileUpdate
methods.description: Callback triggered upon changes to the timezone file; reads the file content, trims it, and updates the environment variable if the timezone has changed.

methods.name: TimeZoneSupport
methods.description: Constructor that initializes member variables, including setting the timezone filename.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Sets up the timezone file monitor, reads the initial timezone, and registers the change callback.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up the file monitor signal handler and reference.
